image_pattern_summary: Verified good images show portable security cabins photographed from a 3/4 or front angle that reveals at least two faces simultaneously — door face and window face — allowing buyers to assess form factor, door type, window placement, and exterior finish in a single view. Cabins are typically shown in real-world deployment contexts (roadside checkpoints, construction yards, outdoor paved areas) or manufacturing yards, providing buyers with a sense of scale and practical deployment. Key structural elements — door, window(s), roof type (flat or pitched), base frame, and exterior panel material/finish — are all clearly distinguishable in every good image.

reason: Portable security cabins are physical structures whose key buyer information (size, material, door/window configuration, exterior finish) is conveyed entirely by the visual form of the product, not by text printed on the surface.

Verified good images show painted/coated exterior panels (steel, FRP, UPVC) with no spec labels or data plates visible; OCR would extract only incidental brand logos or signage, not product specifications.

acceptable_scenes: Outdoor deployment at roadside, construction site, or gate entry point
Manufacturing yard or factory setting showing finished product before delivery
